title: Checkpoint: two-method FRQ under contract
prompt: A complete Q1-style question: (a) `int countWords(String s)`: words are maximal runs of non-space characters; s may have leading/trailing/multiple spaces;  has 0 words. (b) `String longestWord(String s)`: the longest word, earliest on ties ( returns ). Both from scratch — run the full eight-step workflow on paper first.

tests.name: word metrics
tests.hint: Scan for run starts; track current run length; on run end compare with best (strict > keeps earliest).
